changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.subtitle: Last 5 releases
v260: Added a direct bug report and suggestion module in the footer
Integration with a secure e-mail notification backend (Resend API)
Diagnostic metadata attached to help analyse shop-floor issues
v250: Added bolt circle (PCD) module with SVG preview and G-code point export
Added angled hole row coordinate calculator
Added True Position calculator with PASS/FAIL validation and MMC bonus
v240: Added multi-language support (PL, EN, DE, IT)
Added Metric (mm) / Imperial (inch, SFM) unit switcher
v230: New modules: retaining ring grooves (DIN 471/472), parallel keys (DIN 6885), O-ring grooves (ISO 3601)
New theoretical surface roughness Ra/Rz calculator
v220: Smart comma and dot handling in numeric fields
